sources.title: Kirkkonummi, Finland - Project Updates (main contractor's construction bulletin for the Kirkkonummi data-centre project, updated 24/9/2026)
sources.summary: The main contractor's bilingual (Finnish and English) project-status bulletin for the Kirkkonummi data-centre project (project status 'In progress'; newsletter address HEL04community@...), updated on 24/9/2026, is an autumn bulletin written after the summer holidays: construction activities on both data centre buildings are progressing as planned. Currently underway in the first data centre building: equipment deliveries and installations, internal building works, asphalt paving, stone paving and landscaping of external areas, and civil and structural works for auxiliary buildings supporting the data centre. Currently underway in the second data centre building: earthworks, structural steel installation, facade works, roofing works and concrete floor works. Upcoming: test runs of the data centre's backup generators (scheduled, not reported as done). No completion, commissioning, energisation or operation of either building is stated, and no capacity is given.
sources.date_semantics: The bulletin carries its own explicit date in both language sections ('Päivitetty 24/9/2026' / 'Updated on 24/9/2026'), used as published_at and as the observation date of the works it lists as currently underway. The page is a running bulletin whose dated text is replaced at each update: the Internet Archive copy of 15 May 2026 (wb-winthrop-kirkkonummi-20260515.html, sha256 3bb5c1b2b7acb39ce7572883601b25c654ee50afa7b75d2dc9b500adeba1f67d) carries a different winter bulletin 'Updated on 19/02/2026', and the Atlas already records the 26 June 2026 bulletin from the same URL. The 24 September text is new content (an autumn greeting after the summer holidays, with a separate list of works for each of the two buildings), and the site's page sitemap lists the page with lastmod 2026-09-25T14:24:58Z; the bulletin date is therefore not a CMS modification stamp applied to older text. Retrieval on 27 October 2026 is not used as an observation date.
sources.personal_data_note: The page lists named site contacts with telephone numbers and e-mail addresses; none is reproduced. Only the company name and the generic project newsletter address prefix are referred to.

sources.title: Meluavat työt datakeskuksen työmaalla jatkuvat (Noisy works at the data-centre construction site continue), City of Loviisa, 7 October 2026
sources.summary: The City of Loviisa's notice of 7 October 2026 states that Kreate Oy's earthworks (maarakentamistyöt) at the data-centre construction site continue until the end of November, the amount of work having been larger than expected, and that the noisiest work phases are expected to be completed at the end of October. It identifies the site as Hyperco's future data-centre operating area ('Datakeskus Hyperconin tuleva toiminta-alue') south of the bypass / national road 7 along Itäinen Liittymä in Loviisa, and repeats the hours permitted under the environmental authority's noise decision for crushing and quarrying, blasting, rock breaking, loading and transport. No building construction, completion, commissioning or operation of the data centre is stated.
sources.date_semantics: The notice carries its own date (07.10.2026) above the headline and in its structured data (datePublished 2026-10-07T04:20:11Z, dateModified one second later); it is a new post, distinct from the city's earlier notice of 2 July 2026 with the same headline (already in the Atlas). 7 October 2026 is used as published_at and as the observation date of the works it reports as continuing. The expected end of the earthworks (end of November) and of the noisiest phases (end of October) are forecasts and are not used.
sources.personal_data_note: The notice names a contractor contact and a municipal inspector with telephone numbers and e-mail addresses; none is reproduced. Only company names are used.
